# Sportsnet

> > Canadian sports media platform offering live streaming of NHL, NBA, and MLB games, plus sports radio content from Sportsnet 590 The FAN.

Sportsnet provides comprehensive sports coverage including live game streaming, dedicated shows like The Raptors Show with Blake Murphy and Matt Bonner, and integration with TV Guide for scheduling. The platform serves primarily Canadian audiences with geo-restricted access for international users.

## Live Sports Streaming

- [Sportsnet](https://ftv-app.sportsnet.ca): Live sports streaming homepage featuring NHL games and upcoming events
- [Sportsnet - Detroit @ Toronto](https://watch.sportsnet.ca/event/Detroit_Toronto_208512): NBA game streaming page: Detroit vs Toronto with live schedule
- [Live Sports On TV Today - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/sports/live-today): Daily live sports schedule covering MLB, NBA, NHL, and World Baseball Classic

## Sports Radio & Shows

- [The Raptors Show | Sportsnet](https://sportsnet.ca/590/raptors-show): Weekday NBA radio show (11AM-12PM ET) on Sportsnet 590 The FAN
- [Sportsnet - The Raptors Show: March 10](https://watch.sportsnet.ca/event/The_Raptors_Show_March_10_208228): Raptors analysis show replay with Blake Murphy and Matt Bonner
- [Sportsnet 590 – Mobile](https://sportsnet.ca/590-mobile): Mobile app info and SMS service for Sportsnet 590 The FAN radio

## TV Guide & Listings

- [TV Guide - Homepage](https://tvguide.com): Main homepage with streaming recommendations and entertainment news
- [TV Guide, TV Listings](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV schedule and listings homepage for shows, movies, and programs
- [The Complete Guide to Winter TV 2025-2026](https://tvguide.com/news/features/winter-tv-guide-2025): Comprehensive winter TV preview featuring Stranger Things and Bridgerton
- [The New Shows of the 2026 Winter TV Season](https://tvguide.com/galleries/the-new-shows-of-the-2025-2026-winter-tv-season): Gallery of 2026 winter premieres from Game of Thrones and Star Trek franchises

## Streaming Recommendations

- [The 55 Best Shows on Netflix Right Now (March 2026)](https://tvguide.com/news/the-best-shows-on-netflix): Curated list of top Netflix shows featuring Vladimir and Interview w/ Vampire
- [The 61 Best Movies on Netflix Right Now (March 2026)](https://tvguide.com/news/best-movies-on-netflix): Netflix movie recommendations including Jurassic World Rebirth and The Iron Claw
